title: Repair reported first-install, protocol and authentication defects

costar.context: The owner reported five concrete defects in the pre-release mail host.
costar.objective: Repair the existing implementation and preserve capabilities and permission boundaries.
costar.response: Commit fixes with observed checks and explicit unverified live behavior.

concerns: The verified rules feed is still externally maintained. Repairing the typo does not establish owned rules or code independence.
Persisted defaults must be handled without overwriting custom URLs, disabled downloads or custom greetings.
Creating directories in Rust alone does not give the non-root container permission under /var/log.
Account schema requires a domain. Server-only administrator versus explicitly chosen mailbox domain is awaiting owner clarification; do not silently invent an identity model.
Short-name authentication must never guess between multiple accounts across domains or bypass MFA, permissions and app-password validation.
No Docker engine is available locally. Live installation, protocol, recovery and non-root volume checks remain unverified until run on a disposable candidate.
context: Baseline e952af3469919c7519b3b82468f5ccae4ae88837 on main. PostgreSQL install support exists; runtime parity and independence remain open.
current_state: Bad generated spam URL, absent log directory creation and container ownership, old protocol greetings, missing host ManageSieve mapping, inconsistent login labels, implicit setup domain creation and default-domain-only short-name resolution.
target_design: Working configurable rule downloads; writable persistent file logging; ShippinTECH protocol display text; configurable ManageSieve TCP publication; consistent account-name login and explicit setup identity semantics.
changes: Correct the known invalid spam feed default and only that persisted typo; align SMTP schema/default/fallback and IMAP branding.
Create log directories with error reporting and provision container ownership plus persistent log volume.
Publish ManageSieve 4190 using the existing mail bind policy and document firewall/port overrides.

Repair the observed candidate image build blocker: pin the FoundationDB client to bundled server version 7.4.6 and verify its published checksum instead of selecting from the moving releases API. Product release/version remains unchanged.
Run focused Rust regression tests in Linux CI, including the short-name integration case whose Windows build is blocked by missing OpenSSL development libraries.
Use Account name consistently throughout password sign-in.
Resolve setup identity clarification before changing account creation.

Preserve existing default-domain directory and account short-name routing; when neither applies, use an exact indexed User name lookup, require a unique match, and qualify it before the existing credential/MFA/permission checks. Unknown names retain default-directory behavior; ambiguous non-default names require full addresses.
boundaries: No release tags, real-user mail, PRs, global rebranding or unrelated engine rewrites.
Keep PostgreSQL default and FoundationDB scale profiles, existing protocol capabilities, custom settings and authentication checks.
No claim that a repaired external feed makes the product independent.

verification.name: Rust runtime checks
verification.command: cargo test -p common --lib --locked; cargo check -p shippin-tech --locked --no-default-features --features postgres,s3,nats,enterprise
verification.proves: Common runtime unit suite including new directory creation/append/error and targeted persisted-default tests; application compile
verification.expected: Pass; report actual build or execution failures
verification.result: 161 common unit tests passed, zero failures. PostgreSQL/S3/NATS/enterprise application check passed. An extra common-only --features enterprise invocation failed because that standalone feature selection omits store/enterprise; no product code was changed to hide it. Supported application profile compiles.

verification.name: Short-name integration
verification.command: STORE=Sqlite cargo test -p tests --locked --no-default-features --features sqlite install_defects_short_names -- --nocapture
verification.proves: Real account creation, unique other-domain login, group exclusion, ambiguous-name refusal, full-address access, default-domain precedence and no password fallback across accounts
verification.expected: Pass on disposable SQLite test server
verification.result: Windows compilation blocked by missing OpenSSL development libraries before test execution. Added this test to Linux Check workflow with OpenSSL packages; execution pending.

verification.name: Whole web and deployment gate
verification.proves: All UI contracts, checks, unit/browser suites and deployment harnesses continue to pass
verification.expected: No new failures; missing live gates stay unverified
verification.result: 18 passed, zero failed, one not-run (relay requires POSIX permissions), ten live/engine steps omitted. Includes 289 unit tests, 12 mocked browser tests, zero Svelte errors/warnings, static build, registry, lint, API/inventory/MCPL and installer/update/backup/host harnesses. Runner exits 1 correctly for missing coverage. Evidence: ignored roadmap/regression-results.partial.json, baseline e952af3 plus working changes; recorded old image identity is not candidate runtime proof.

verification.name: Compose and schema configuration
verification.command: Compose config --format json for bundled,postgres and bundled,foundationdb; validate schema gzip digest/defaults and CI YAML
verification.proves: Both storage selections retain the host port/log mount and embedded schema matches runtime defaults
verification.expected: 4190 mapped under the configured mail bind; node-logs mounted at /var/log/shippin.tech
verification.result: Both profiles validated with Compose 5.8.0: 0.0.0.0:4190 to container 4190 and node-logs mount present. Schema digest and corrected SMTP/spam defaults validated; CI YAML parsed. Operating-record checker passed: 6 modules, 56 documents.

verification.name: Pinned build dependency
verification.command: Download official FoundationDB 7.4.6 amd64 client and compare SHA-256
verification.proves: Replacement download exists and matches published checksum
verification.expected: Pinned client matches bundled server; no moving API query
verification.result: Downloaded amd64 package matches 7e29df033c3d1d27701d094651cf87a36fa5b0afc2896c8e4aaf47f549e68365. ARM64 asset existence verified through official GitHub release metadata; ARM64 build unverified.

verification.name: Live disposable installation
verification.command: Build candidate image and run live first-run, mail protocol, log and recovery checks
verification.proves: Actual integrated behavior under non-root Linux container
verification.expected: Required before live parity can be claimed
verification.result: Pending: local Docker engine unavailable. Previous candidate's FoundationDB download failure addressed and downloaded package verified, but complete candidate build/install remains unverified. Setup domain/identity change awaits owner choice; this plan remains draft rather than claiming all five reports resolved.
